name: Wisdom Of God The
overview: The Wisdom of God is revealed as an attribute that encompasses perfect knowledge and understanding of human affliction, actions, and hearts, as seen in God's awareness of His people's sufferings and His intimate knowledge of their thoughts (Exodus 3:7; 1 Chronicles 28:9). Scripture shows that this divine wisdom guides the faithful in righteous living and governance, exemplified by Ezra's use of God's wisdom to appoint judges and teach the law (Ezra 7:25). The Lord's wisdom is mighty, incomparable, and infinite, underscoring His sovereign ability to weigh actions and search the hearts of His saints (1 Samuel 2:3; 2 Samuel 7:20).
